author: Joe Rutland
title: NBA Fans Roast Clippers With Kawhi Leonard Scandal References Amid 30-Point Blowout vs. Jazz - NewsBreak
text:
By Joe Rutland ,
31 minutes ago
The Los Angeles Clippers have had a very eventful offseason, with a scandal involving star player Kawhi Leonard and team owner Steve Ballmer. The Clippers were probably looking forward to starting the new 2025-26 NBA season and starting quickly.
Well, that didn’t happen on Wednesday night against the Utah Jazz. In fact, the first quarter saw the Jazz holding an incredible 43-19 lead over the Clippers with Leonard and James Harden watching the disaster unfold. The Jazz finished off the Clippers 129-108 for their first win of the season.
Clippers and NBA fans were not holding back in their disdain for what they saw on the court.
What Were Fans Saying About Clippers’ Awful Start? Leonard, with the Jazz holding a comfortable lead in the fourth quarter at Delta Center in Salt Lake City, finished with 10 points in 29 minutes on the floor. For his part, Harden finished with 15 points in 29 minutes of play.
This NBA fan didn’t forget about the case involving Leonard, Ballmer, and Aspiration. In fact, the fan commented on it while also showing off the Clippers-Jazz halftime score.
Another NBA fan decided to show how much the person could not believe how the Clippers pretty much laid an egg in the first half. The fan wrote on X , “Good lord, Clippers….”
As for this one, the person couldn’t believe that the Clippers were losing to a team that started Svi Mykhailiuk in its starting rotation. The fan wrote, “Clippers down 37 to a team that started Svi Mykhailiuk”.
This NBA fan must have wanted to let Clippers fans know that they were putting their faith in the wrong player. The fan posted on X, “Clippers fans realizing they got baited into believing in another Kawhi Leonard Clippers team”.
Ballmer wasn’t let off the hook, either. Apparently, this fan wanted to send a special message Ballmer’s way, especially when bringing up Lawrence Frank’s name. The fan wrote, “Steve Ballmer when being asked about the job Lawrence Frank has done with The Clippers”.
Finally, “Inside the NBA” commentators Charles Barkley and Shaquille O’Neal got into the act by giving Leonard a hard time. “Charles Barkley: ‘Well Kawhi got 2 jobs…He can’t work 2 jobs and play basketball.’,” Barkley said. What about Shaq? Oh, he got his shot in, too, and said, “He got an NIL deal from the Clippers.”
There’s only one way to go from here for Clippers head coach Ty Lue and his team. Is that up, or will this be a season where the Clippers aren’t a competitive team in the NBA’s Western Conference?
There will be time to review what happened in Utah, but NBA and Clippers fans will not forget this forgettable performance anytime soon.
